as_told.title: Tim Taylor carries credentials from multiple intelligence agencies

plain: A man named Timothy Taylor, linked to NASA, is said to carry credentials from several US intelligence agencies, hinting at a hidden space program. Michels says that according to Diana Pasulka, a scholar who writes about UFO belief, Taylor "seemed to flash all these like three-letter agency credentials" at her. A researcher who goes by UAPGerb says, without naming a source, that Taylor walks around with credentials from many agencies, including access to the NRO, the US agency that runs spy satellites. If true, it would suggest a secret program working beyond the public space agency.
